option.name: originalContent
option.value:
# filepath: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generate_umbrella.cmake # Helper cmake script invoked by add_custom_command to generate the umbrella header # Expects two variables passed on the command line: # -DREPO_SRC_DIR: absolute path to the repository "src" folder # -DOUT_FILE: absolute path to the output umbrella header to write
if(NOT REPO_SRC_DIR) message(FATAL_ERROR "generate_umbrella.cmake requires -DREPO_SRC_DIR to be set") endif() if(NOT OUT_FILE) message(FATAL_ERROR "generate_umbrella.cmake requires -DOUT_FILE to be set") endif()
message(STATUS "Generating umbrella header at: ${OUT_FILE} from headers under: ${REPO_SRC_DIR}/*.hpp")
# Collect headers under REPO_SRC_DIR file(GLOB_RECURSE ALL_HEADERS "${REPO_SRC_DIR}/*.hpp") message(STATUS "Found ${ALL_HEADERS}") # Remove the umbrella header itself if present to avoid self-include list(REMOVE_ITEM ALL_HEADERS "${OUT_FILE}")
# Sort the list for deterministic output list(SORT ALL_HEADERS)
# Write the file header and pragma once file(WRITE "${OUT_FILE}" "// Automatically generated umbrella header clang-format off NOLINT(legal/copyright)\n#pragma once\n\n")
# Append includes relative to REPO_SRC_DIR foreach(h ${ALL_HEADERS}) file(RELATIVE_PATH rel_path "${REPO_REL_DIR}" "${h}") # Normalize: replace backslashes with forward slashes (Windows) string(REPLACE "\\" "/" rel_path "${rel_path}") file(APPEND "${OUT_FILE}" "#include \"${rel_path}\"\n") message(STATUS "Including header: ${rel_path} in umbrella header: ${OUT_FILE}") endforeach()
# Copy headers to build/include preserving folder structure -------------------- # add the umbrella header to the list foreach(h ${ALL_HEADERS} ${OUT_FILE}) message("Copied header: ${h} to build include directory: ${dest}") # Compute relative path inside file(RELATIVE_PATH rel_path "${REPO_REL_DIR}" "${h}")
set(dest "${BUILD_INCLUDE_DIR}/${rel_path}")
# Make sure destination folder exists get_filename_component(dest_dir "${dest}" DIRECTORY) file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${dest_dir}")
# Copy header configure_file("${h}" "${dest}" COPYONLY) message("Copied header: ${rel_path} to build include directory: ${dest}") endforeach()
